That brings our coverage of this one-off T20I in Kanto to an end. Japan put up a spirited fight and can take plenty of positives from the contest. With the Asian Games now drawing closer, India will be keen to raise their performance levels over the next couple of weeks. The pitches at the Asian Games are expected to provide better batting and playing conditions than the surface we saw today. Japan will begin their campaign against Afghanistan and it will be intriguing to see if they can make it through to the quarter-finals. India’s tour of Japan is also a significant milestone in the growth and development of cricket in the country, and hopefully many more such memorable moments lie ahead.
